notes.title: The art of movement
notes.content:
Hello everyone on the next production devlog!
Today we will tell you about the new locomotion system that was implemented in the game.

We can already boast of implementing basic movement, dynamic running, stealth and even combat.
The system in question is significantly different from the previous one that you have already seen on gifs or short gameplays.
Now our Ninja moves like a cat and additional animation, such as the realistic turning of the hero with the camera, is simply phenomenal!

The protagonist will also stick his hands out to maintain balance by walking on thin ropes or platforms. All these details add a lot of realism to the game and make it a lot of fun to play.

Now we can safely say that the hero moves like a real Shinobi!

Apart from the huge success in implementing the new locomotion system, we can tell you that the prologue is still being developed, we are adding new additional activities to it and polish everything we have done so far.

We are proud of what we have achieved so far and look forward to showing you the results.

On behalf of the entire Ninja Simulator team, I would also like to wish everyone a Happy New Year! Thank you for being with us!


*The GIFs that we show you here are from the work on new mechanics (these are not the final results)

notes.title: Patience pays off
notes.content:
Hello Adepts on the next devlog!
This month, we'll tell you about the changes to the title and show you the effect of these changes.

There have been a lot of changes to the combat system in the game. The mechanics have been simplified and the finisher system has been changed to one that will be easier to master. Now, to finish off your opponent, you need to deal enough damage to him so that he is weakened, which will allow you to perform an effective finisher!

Now there are many more finishing blows and they are really good!
The stealth killi system has also changed, now there are more of them and they look even better!

The character animations themselves have also changed, the hero moves smoother and more reliably. We have changed virtually all of the animations related to movement such as running, walking, stealth, idle and all of these variants combined with different weapons.

We are now working on standardizing the UI (user interface) and on a better climbing system.

The game looks really great now. Take a look at some of the animations and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Cat agility
notes.content:
Welcome to the next devlog!
Today we will tell you about the next progress on the game.

The changelog is long, but we'll summarize it to the most important information.

A lot of work this month has been devoted to special sounds, we are talking about things like:
- Movement audio (sound of air while falling, sound of hitting the ground, sound of special movements)
- Character and enemy sounds (Damage sounds, shouts, calls, etc.)
- Sounds of special gadgets such as smoke bombs or grappling hook.

Additionally, we've added more realistic bloodstains that now remain on the environment.

We're still working on improving the combat system, and we can't wait to show you the results!
In combat, the animations, the length of the basic combo and the finisher mechanics have changed. We want to get to such a point that the elimination of opponents itself is a great pleasure.

Grappling Hook has also been added and we have to admit that snapping with it is a lot of fun!

notes.title: Vigilance is essential.
notes.content:
Hello all ninja to the new devlog!
The current month of work on the game was focused mainly on improving what we already have. We are working on the combat system to be dynamic and not too difficult for new players.

We will extend the combo so that the player feels the strength of his warrior. Now it's easier in the game to die in open combat, we want the player to feel that close combat is challenging and to think about their move before entering combat.

We've also added new realistic blood that spurts all over the place!

In addition, from the technical side, we changed the collision system, now, in order to hit the enemy, the sword must actually hit the model, not just its capsules. Thanks to this solution, movements such as jumping over a sword flying low or crouching when the sword is flying high are possible.

Some time ago we did a poll on our discord channel asking players if they would like to see grappling hook in the game. A month later, we can enjoy the working mechanics that added a lot of ninja atmosphere to the game.

From the stylistic changes, we polish the first map, optimize it and change the light to darker, the fog is denser, thanks to which the game has its own unique atmosphere.

That's all for today, I leave you with some screenshots.
Stay alert like true ninja!

notes.title: Production news!
notes.content:
Welcome to our second devlog! We are glad that the interest in the game is so great and thank you for your commitment and support!
We take all your suggestions and make the game better and better. We are just at the stage of building artificial intelligence for our opponents and we are testing the combat system so that it gives players the greatest fun.

Do you have an idea of how to make the game even better? Share your ideas on our discord channel!

We invite everyone who has not yet taken part in our discussion to our discord. More news coming soon!

Discord: https://discord.gg/Tvh9ZUW

notes.title: First Devlog!
notes.content:
Welcome to the first post about the production of the Ninja Simulator! 

We are happy that we can share the results of our work and cooperate with you on creating the game!
At the moment, we are at the stage of building a combat system that will surely delight you. 

We are waiting for your ideas and we want to invite you to our discord server where you can share your opinions and have a real impact on the process of creating the game. 

Stay tuned for new entries and screenshots!

Discord Channel : [url]https://discord.gg/Tvh9ZUW[/url]
